body:
Someone finally finds a legitimate channel for the long-swallowed objection.

They turn the grievance into an agenda item, a formal complaint, a proposal to change the rule; the anger gets a job instead of a target.

With Mars sextile Lilith, the people who know the procedure can lend it to a refusal that never had one.

The channel is open now, but someone has to file while the office is.

The channel may close unused, but anger that people give a procedure stops needing an ambush.
